Marry or Move On include Queer Love.

There are 3 seasons of The Ultimatum available to stream on Netflix.
The Ultimatum series is available exclusively on Netflix.
In The Ultimatum Netflix series, one partner is ready for marriage while the other is not.
In The Ultimatum Netflix series, the hesitant partner is given an ultimatum: marry or move on.
In The Ultimatum Netflix series, couples separate, date other people, and shack up with a new potential match for three weeks to test their love before deciding on their original relationship.
An ultimatum is a final demand or proposal, the rejection of which will result in the end of negotiations or a relationship.
An ultimatum is often a short-term deadline set to compel a specific action, usually backed by a threat of consequences if complied with.
The Ultimatum Game is a game theory experiment where one player (proposer) divides a sum of money and proposes a split.
In the Ultimatum Game, the second player (responder) can accept (both get money) or reject (neither gets money) the offer.
